root.text: Card 03 · TRN-02 · Create an industrial property tax bill for this year (web)

children.text:
Story: As a treasury clerk, I want to create a real property tax bill for an industrial property this year so that the city can collect its Basic and SEF (Special Education Fund) tax.
Acceptance criteria:
- Basic = 2% of the assessed value
- SEF = 1% of the assessed value
- Both lines start OPEN
- Wrong values and a wrong PIN are refused with a clear message; one PIN per city
- The bill shows in My data › My bills, and only to me
Setup on the screen: Home › Create my data › section 1 › Create taxpayer › Create a property tax bill for this taxpayer
Training setup › section 2: create the bill

W1 · Core + · Section 2 opens with its fields
Steps: Home › Create my data
→ On screen: heading "2 — Create a property tax bill"; Taxpayer (only yours are listed); Property class RESIDENTIAL; Tax year 2026

W2 · Numbers − · Assessed value 0
Steps: PIN new, INDUSTRIAL, Assessed value 0, Tax year 2026 › Create property tax bill
→ On screen: under Assessed value: "must be greater than 0"; no "Bill … created:" box

W3 · Syntax − · PIN with 4 groups
Steps: PIN 603-26-482-100, Assessed value 1000.00 › Create property tax bill
→ On screen: under PIN: "must match NNN-NN-NNN-NNN-NNN"
3 decimals, 1000000000.00, 999999999.99: at the API (Session 5 T5, T9, T10)

W4 · Core + · Create the bill
Steps: PIN new, INDUSTRIAL, Assessed value 1000000.00, Tax year 2026 › Create property tax bill
→ On screen: "Bill <PIN> created:" with rows RPT 20000.00 and RPT_SEF 10000.00

W5 · Claims − · The same PIN a second time
Steps: right after W4, click Create property tax bill again
→ On screen: under PIN: "already taken for this tenant"
My data › My bills: see the bill

W6 · Core + · My bill is in My bills
Steps: top bar › My data
→ On screen: row RPT <PIN> | INDUSTRIAL 2026 | 1000000.00 | OPEN
Only to me: another name-tag sees none of my bills (Card 20 journey; at the API: Session 5 T8)
Manual: is section 2 clear for a clerk? (labels, order, the PIN hint)
Risk: a wrong rate or rounding bills the owner the wrong tax for the whole year
Coverage: what the clerk sees: the form, two field messages, the result box, the PIN rule, the My bills row. Leaves out: other field rules (API), payment
